text:
The best clinic! I had a speck of dust in my eye that wouldn't come out with a cotton swab. We went to the clinic through our insurance, where they took the money, but couldn't help us. We started looking for a private ophthalmologist and found this one. The doctor was very kind and translated everything she was going to do. In the end, she used a needle (!) to remove a metal shaving (!) that was embedded in my eye! They prescribed and gave me medication (no need to go to the pharmacy). And all this took 30 minutes, including paperwork. By the way, we are Russian and don't speak English, so with the help of a translator, we were able to explain everything without any problem.
The price is even lower than in a private Russian office.
5 stars and may your clinic prosper!

text: After asking by phone, I visited Dr. Patchara today with a small foreign body in my eye. The problem was quickly identified, the eye was lightly anesthetized, and the foreign body was removed. I was given antibiotic eye drops, a medical report in English, and everything was explained perfectly. A perfect, quick treatment at a reasonable cost. Dr. Patchara and her staff were very accommodating. Parking space is in front of the clinic. I highly recommend this clinic.
